Name: Cuter Maru Sprite for 1.6
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This mod is a updated port for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16276]Cuter Maru Sprite[/url]﻿ Mod to work with 1.6 with new winter outfit sprites, added in the missing sprites (waving and sleeping sprite) not included which would have caused errors in-game and updated the code to follow the new content patcher format!

You can use the Generic Mod Configuration Menu to enable/disable any sprite

Let me know if there's any bugs

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img]
[/url]
Using the GMCM you can enable/disable any sprite for easy compatibility with other mods :) and you can choose
between the normal and alternative eyes styles


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you[b] canddleit[/b] for the lovely original mod you can find it [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cuter-maru-sprite.145058/]here [/url]﻿^-^ it was fun porting to 1.6

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85501773]binyks[/url] for the 1.5 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16276]updated sprite mod [/url]﻿adding in the missing swimsuit sprite, and for allowing for uploads of this content elsewhere, but to please mark [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85501773]binyks[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78801143]Peasant00[/url] and [b]canddleit[/b]'s names, as well as a link to the original mod: Which, as said in the Mod Details, you can find[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cuter-maru-sprite.145058/] here[/url]﻿!

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78801143]Peasant00[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10185]original content patcher [/url]﻿release for 1.4

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
